title: The 1943 Philadelphia Experiment

tellings.quote: Legend has it that in 1943, the Navy tried to teleport a ship in what's now known as the Philadelphia experiment, and it kind of worked. It disappeared, reappeared, and then half the crew got atomically fused into the ship's walls.

plain: In 1943, legend has it, the US Navy tried to teleport a ship in what is now called the Philadelphia Experiment, and it partly worked: the ship vanished, came back, and half the crew were fused into its walls. Michels tells it openly as a legend and links it to the anti-gravity researcher Thomas Townsend Brown. If it were true, the Navy would have been toying with physics far beyond anything publicly known during the Second World War.
